critical.issue: Full-replace semantics on a model with defaults. SupportConfigIn declares every field with a default (e.g. avatar_id: str = '', knowledge: str = '', system_prompt: str = '', avatar_name: str = ''), and admin_set() does `set_config(x.model_dump())`. So a legitimate PATCH-style call like {video_credits_per_sec:3} silently wipes avatar_id, avatar_name, avatar_preview, system_prompt, knowledge, portrait, etc. to their defaults. That immediately turns GET /api/support/video-config into {enabled:false,...} because the enabled flag requires avatar_id to be truthy. In the UI this makes rt-video-toggle disappear from the Oryntix realtime call for every user. During this test run the admin credit-roundtrip test exposed the bug (avatar_id was wiped to ''); I manually restored it via a second PUT including avatar_id. Highly reproducible — any admin tweak via the admin panel that doesn't resend ALL fields will nuke the config.

rca of the issue: Critical: PUT /api/admin/support-agent treats partial payloads as full replacements. Repro: `curl -X PUT -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>' -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"video_credits_per_sec":3}' /api/admin/support-agent` → the stored config loses avatar_id/system_prompt/knowledge/avatar_name/avatar_preview because SupportConfigIn applies defaults for omitted fields, and admin_set dumps the whole model into set_config(). Consequence: /api/support/video-config returns enabled:false (its truthiness check is `video_enabled AND avatar_id AND LIVEAVATAR_API_KEY`), which hides the rt-video-toggle button in the Realtime call UI across the whole workspace. Mitigation applied during test: issued a compensating PUT that re-sends avatar_id/avatar_name/avatar_preview along with the credits-per-sec. Permanent fix: switch to a Patch model with Optional fields and only merge provided keys.
